answer: Because the timing is recorded against the haven challenge, the island audit can replay the pearl history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 24 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which forfeits the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 2791 identities would post 3919 proofs and burn roughly 26 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
